description: Striker's Pauldrons Level 60 Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Command, 2 Idols of War, 5 Crystal Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Neutral reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest. Requirements: - Qiraji Bindings of Command - Idol of War x 2 - Crystal Scarab x 5 - Ivory Scarab x 5 - Brood of Nozdormu:
